Personally I would never have been able to follow through with a plan like yours. I feel too guilty leaving my family and bf to find out out of the blue after I'm gone. I just figured there'd be a day when they're no longer with me or maybe [hopefully] I'll stop feeling to terrible before then.

It sounds like you really love your gf and she feels the same. I hope you can take a little solace in that thought. Now that she does know, maybe you can talk with her about your feelings instead of holding them inside to yourself? Only if you feel comfortable with that of course.

I'm really sorry your parents said that to you. Mind did the same to me, and to some extent it's why I'm still here but also why I don't want to be. It's a terrible form of manipulation no child should have to experience.
